summary: A 1939 camp with a crow's nest in the Coeur d'Alene National Forest, abandoned in 1941. A 2024 visit found no remnants of the camp and no tree with a full set of identifying markers.

facts.status_note: Abandoned in 1941; a 2024 visit found no remnants of the camp and no tree with a full set of identifying markers.

corrections.why: The Forest Fire Lookout Association index lists the type as Crowsnest, and firelookout.com describes a camp with a crow's nest. The record has kind unknown.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Forest Fire Lookout Association index puts the site at 47.87037, -116.15685, about 29 km from the record point. firelookout.com places it 13 miles north of Wallace, which matches the record point (47.66394, -115.92788). The record point is kept.

notes_for_editor: Staffing is undocumented in every source, so the story leaves it out. Two conflicts need a human look: (1) the record point matches firelookout.com's 13 miles north of Wallace, but the FFLA index point is about 29 km away; check which one a map pin should use. (2) Elevation: 4,424 ft (firelookout.com) vs 4,400 ft (Idaho Fire Lookouts); the story gives both. The kind correction uses the index label 'Crowsnest'; map it to the app's kind vocabulary. The Idaho Fire Lookouts article is dated September 16, 2024, but gives no visit date.
